roundDescs: Your cell's electronic lock. The guard passes by again in a few seconds. Perfect timing opens it silently.
You're in the corridor. A magnetic gate blocks the way. It opens in bursts. You need to catch the exact window.
The outer door. The main system. The most sensitive one. One wrong move and the whole prison lights up.
betweenMsgs: The cell is open. You move down the corridor, back to the walls. A guard turns away.
You cross the gate. The exit is in sight. One last obstacle.

events.theft: Someone searches your belongings during the night. −{{amount}} cr.
events.illness: You fall ill. The infirmary is a fiction here. −{{loss}} max HP (permanent).
events.interrogation: Surprise interrogation. Nothing new — but it wears you down. −5 rep.
events.solidarity: A cellmate shares their ration. A rare gesture. +{{heal}} HP.
events.information: You overhear a conversation through the walls. Names, routes. It sticks.
events.nothing: Another day. The walls don't change.

cautionJournal: I paid bail at {{station}}. {{amount}} credits. Freedom has a price.
cautionMsg: Bail paid. −{{amount}} cr. 60% HP. −8 rep. {{fraction}} recovered.
bribeJournal: I bribed a guard at {{station}}. He looked the other way. I got out.
bribeSuccessMsg: The guard pockets the {{amount}} cr and looks away. {{hp}} HP. {{fraction}} recovered.
bribeFailMsg: He takes the money AND calls for backup. +1 day. {{days}} days left.
cellmateDesc: He has the look of someone with nothing left to lose. In a cell, that's the worst kind of opponent.
ignoreCellmateMsg: You ignore him. He hits you from behind. −{{dmg}} HP.
escapeJournal: I escaped from the prison at {{station}}. Three obstacles. Then the void. I ran.

execution.body1b: Stupidity has its own limits — you crossed every one of them,
execution.body1c: one after another, with an almost admirable consistency.
execution.body2a: You were given more than one chance.
execution.body2c: Death row isn't made for smart people.
execution.body3a: Your items were split among the guards.
execution.deathCause: Executed after three failed escape attempts. Stupidity has its limits.

finalRoll.title: — ESCAPE — Last door crossed —
finalRoll.body: You made it through all three obstacles. But the space between you and your ship is still watched. 70% chance to vanish into the night. 30% chance they're already waiting.
finalRoll.attempt4: ⚠ ATTEMPT 4/4 — This is your last chance. Failure here means death.
finalRoll.attempt3: ⚠ Attempt 3/4 — You have only one chance left after this one.
finalRoll.attempt2: Attempt 2/4 — Another failure and you recover nothing.
finalRoll.attempt1: Attempt 1/4 — Another failure will cost you 25% of your items.

caught.title: CAUGHT
caught.round1: The lock resists. A silent alarm. Footsteps in the corridor.
caught.round2: The gate blocks you. A guard turns around. He shouts.
caught.round3: So close. The door doesn't open in time. The lights come on.
caught.attemptFatal: ⚠ ATTEMPT {{n}}/{{n}} FAILED — THE NEXT ONE IS DEATH.
caught.attempt2Warn: ⚠ Attempt 2/4 failed — You have 2 chances left before death.

success.title: ESCAPED
success.body: You cross the last door. The cold air of space greets you. You run without looking back until you reach your ship.

menu.title: PRISON
menu.intro: Your belongings were confiscated. Every failed escape attempt worsens the conditions of your release.
menu.cellmateDesc2: A guy in your cell is looking at you like you owe him something. He's looking for trouble — or a way out. Either way, it ends the same.
menu.pleadButton: ⚖ Plead your case before the magistrate
